name: studiocraft
description: L3 egui desktop host for StudioCraft (calls studiocraft-core in-process)

tools.name: studio_status
tools.description: Report StudioCraft version, contract v1, engine probes (down when missing, never faked).

tools.name: studio_caps
tools.description: Show v1 adapter caps: photo<->vector editable, rest preview-linked, with provenance.

tools.name: studio_init
tools.description: Create a new .studiocraft project dir with manifest v1 + native subdirs.

tools.name: studio_open
tools.description: Open and validate an existing .studiocraft project (contract must be studiocraft/v1).

tools.name: studio_list
tools.description: Scan a root dir for .studiocraft projects (max 100 entries).

tools.name: studio_handoff_check
tools.description: Safety gate for one handoff: blocks unsaved/unsupported/non-editable instead of flattening.

tools.name: studio_companion_attach
tools.description: Attach a companion pointer (design/pdf/word/deck/grid/effect/film/cad/sound). Pointer only, never copies bytes.

tools.name: studio_composite_bump
tools.description: Bump manifest revision by 1 after a verified round-trip (checked_add, no silent reset).

tools.name: studio_skills
tools.description: List guided StudioCraft skills (round-trip, safe gate, companion, rescue, hygiene, chat recipe).

tools.name: studio_skill_show
tools.description: Show one skill recipe with steps and safety notes.

tools.name: studio_llm_chat
tools.description: One LLM chat turn (ollama/lmstudio/openai/anthropic/custom). Keys via args or LLM_API_KEY env, never on disk.

tools.name: studio_llm_models
tools.description: List models for a provider (Anthropic has none: type the model id).
